entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a little while ago. This thing is junk! I want my money back.
I understand your frustration. I'm happy to help you with a return. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer's email address]. And hurry it up! I don't have all day.
Thank you. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse. I understand you'd like to return it. Can you tell me what the issue is?

It doesn't track my sleep properly, the heart rate monitor is all over the place, and the battery barely lasts a day. It's a defective smart watch, plain and simple. I've had it for like, two weeks. This is ridiculous!

I apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced with your VeloBand Pulse. Our return policy is designed to ensure customer satisfaction. Let me just confirm... you purchased it on [date of purchase - 15 days prior to call date]?
Yeah, something like that. Look, I just want to return it and get my money back. What's the hold up?

According to our return policy, you have 90 days from the date of purchase to return an item for a full refund. So, you are well within that window. Let me initiate the return process for your VeloBand Pulse.
90 days? Really? Okay, that's good to hear. I was worried I was outside the window. Great! Just get it done!

Absolutely. To process the return, I will need to send you a prepaid shipping label. It will arrive in your email within the next hour. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse securely in its original packaging, if possible, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, a refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Sounds good. What about the refund? How long will that take?
The refund will typically appear in your account within 7 to 10 business days after we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse. You will receive an email confirmation once the refund has been processed.
Okay, great. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. I appreciate it. You've been very helpful. I was worried I'd have to argue with someone about this. Thanks!
My pleasure! We appreciate your business. Have a great day!
